failure_summary.description: Several calls used a neighboring or less-specific endpoint, the wrong provider, or an incorrect tool identifier instead of the best-matching operation.
Calls mis-mapped explicit constraints to fields or values, including ranges, units, location levels, canonical selectors, and required-versus-optional placement.
Some trajectories added unrelated calls or unsupported blank arguments, and one failed to identify a requested tool correctly.

patch.reasoning: The recurring failures are already directly addressed by the skill's endpoint-eligibility and entity-matching rules, smallest-complete-call-set guidance, schema-specific argument mapping, and final two-way audit. Adding more overlapping instructions would not patch a demonstrated documentation gap.
